method: Nebius' unauthenticated structured catalog API https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/api/public/models_info (listing https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/models). Parsed flavors[].input_price_per_million_tokens / output_price_per_million_tokens and flavors[].regions. The 2026-09-08 catalog has 22 public models (all status:active, all single flavor label 'cheap'); embedding-only Qwen3-Embedding-8B ($0.01/1M input, no text output price) is omitted, leaving 21 text/vision models. Confirmed stable across two fetches. Vs 2026-08-26 (29 rows): 9 models DELISTED (DeepSeek V4 Flash base, MiniMax M2.5, Cosmos3 Super Reasoner, Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, Hermes 4 70B, Qwen3-Next-80B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B), 1 ADDED (GLM-5.3 Flash, $0.15/$0.50, us-central1, 1024K ctx), Nemotron 3.5 Lightning region flapped back us-central1 -> eu-north1; all other prices unchanged. Nebius' catalog flaps — verify per refresh. region 'eu' = eu-north1 (FI) / eu-west2 (FR); 'us' = us-central1; 'uk' = uk-south1. No GLM-5.3 (full), GPT-6, Qwen3.8 Max, Muse Spark, Grok, Claude or DeepSeek V4.1 in the catalog. The marketing pricing page https://nebius.com/prices-ai-studio still 404s (Token Factory replaced AI Studio). All prices are native USD (no EUR conversion needed).
